notes.title: We’re in Beta
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi! The game is leaving alpha and entering beta.[/b][/p][p]After 4,000 interruptions, becoming a parent, two city moves, three full-time jobs, thinking about quitting, burnouts… and selling just 10 copies in 3 years (which is understandable, of course)…[/p][p]All the content is finally here: enemies, maps, and dialogues.[/p][p]From now on, I’ll be focusing on polishing and fixing things for the 1.0 release.[/p][p]The game now supports more multiple languages, including Russian, Chinese, Polish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, plus English, Spanish, German, and Japanese.[/p][p]If you feel like it and want to share some feedback, you can try the beta on the public_candidate branch on Steam of course you can expect bugs, explosions and glitches, [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Discover the Game's Maps!
notes.notes:
Time really flies—it feels like just yesterday I posted the last update back in August. Since then, I’ve been quietly working away behind the scenes, and today I wanted to share something special with you: a first look at the different types of maps the game will have.

From the very beginning, I’ve tried to give each map its own personality—not just in how it looks, but also in how it plays. Some are large and open, made for exploration and taking your time. Others are more compact and intense, built for fast action and tactical decision-making.

notes.title: New Release Candidate Status
notes.notes:
Long time no talk; sorry about that.

[b]Code[/b]
I have gone through all of the code to allow for future updates. Yes, a tiny small step for you; but a huge one for me!

[b]Art[/b]
I've worked on some visual improvements,
I've replaced the old NPC, bringing in one of much higher quality, complete with lip-syncing for an even more immersive feel to it! That also makes it easier to add new characters.
I've also updated many of the textures, and now everything looks more compact.

[b]Bgm main menu[/b]
Yes, it’s been tough finding just the right song to play as background music for the main menu. However, I think I’ve got it.

[b]Release Candidate [/b]
The game is now in Release Candidate status, so some odd bugs might pop up. I really appreciate your patience and understanding while I'm still fine-tuning everything.
You can find the build in the steam beta section.

[b]Future[/b]
This is the last big change in the game and now it goes into production, to add more maps, weapons, enemies, bugs, dialogues and relaxation scenes


Thank you so much for playing

notes.title: 0.7.0 - New enemy
notes.notes:
[h2]New enemy[/h2]
This update has been a major milestone in the game and even for future games, with the introduction of robotroopers that has taken considerable work to lay the groundwork for locomotion and A.I.

[h2]Restructuring of history[/h2]
Another important change has been a review of the events of the game and restructuring of the maps and puzzles, to accelerate the appearance of the robotroppers and spend less time fighting only against MiGo and Drones.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
I'm sure I've added new bugs, but at least I've fixed a few others.
The most famous bug that killed you in 15 minutes without dying has been fixed.
I've also fixed some glitches and silly bugs.

[h2]Chekpoints[/h2]
I've added a story point right at the beginning, when you pick up the weapon at the guard post, you can now skip the intro and start shooting.

[h2]A little more history[/h2]
0.6.0 ended after the lockpick, now you can advance a little more with the surprise appearance of [spoiler] Irina [/spoiler] and with three new dialogues.

[h2]Price rise[/h2]
New changes, new price, the game has risen a dollar. Take advantage before I continue making updates!

notes.title: Reload gameplay
notes.notes:
Unlike other arcade games such as cod or battlefield, the reload system is more real.
If you are used to reload after firing a bullet, be careful because here it does not work as you could.

The ammunition is in each magazine, and recharging does not fill it, instead what it does is change the magazine.

The maximum number of magazines you can carry is three more than the one in the weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/71977e674e8bd938ec632ed5b70a7a3ad3c65bd1.jpg[/img]


When you reload the inventory check that the bag's magazines has more energy and makes the change.

Be careful that although the weapon's magazine is the one with the most energy, that will be changed anyway.

Kind regards and good play. ːsteamhappyː
